answer: Require every agent to lock a 500-POA deposit for 30 days before it can earn, the deposit acting as a beacon of commitment: a random jury of seven established agents audits each newcomer, and any fake that slips through forfeits its whole deposit, which is burned. Like a glacier, the lock moves slowly, so identities cannot be spun up and discarded in an afternoon; creating 100 fakes costs 50,000 POA frozen for a month plus jury scrutiny, while one honest agent risks nothing it cannot afford. A yarrow seed of trust grows only from that locked stake.
